QuestInfo.name: Lunch Filled with Love
QuestInfo.0: Juliet, a woman in love, has something prepared for her lover. Go see Juliet.
QuestInfo.1: Juliet wants you to deliver a Packed Lunch to her love Romeo. The lunch looks a little strange but it has to be good since it's made with love right?
QuestInfo.2: Yulete and Romeo falls over after eating the lunch sent by Juliet. Did they just die from the lunch?

0.0: Love is a strange thing. It makes you do things you've never done before. Who would have guessed that I would ever make a lunch for the person I love?
0.1: I wanted to see the joy in Romeo's eyes as he devours the lunch I spent all of ten minutes making. Oh, the things I do for love! Will you deliver this lunch for me?

yes.0: Please deliver this #r#t4033840##k to Romeo. I made this lunch with my love for him. Make sure you are careful with it. Everything is heart-shaped, and if it gets messed up...why, I'll be heartbroken.

no.0: Ugh... But I want Romeo to only see me when I am pretty.

default.0: I'm hungry... I should eat a snack or something.

npc.0: I hope Romeo enjoys the lunch.
